statement: The five zero-rigid spectral research formulations in the repository — (1) Radial-Defect Quotient (RDQ: Tr R = sum delta^2 / gamma^2), (2) Curvature Transport (B_rho''(0) / (2 (log tau)^2) = delta^2), (3) Pointwise Weil-Hermitian Involution Defect (2 delta^2 / (|rho|^2 |1-rho|^2)), (4) Completed Mean-Square Anchor (CMSA: Delta Z_sigma resolvent response), and (5) Fibre Sesquilinear Form (M_K''(0) = 2 N_gamma sum delta^2) — share the exact critical-line spectral zero set {rho in C : zeta(rho) = 0} (SHARED_SPECTRAL_ZERO_SET_WITH_DISTINCT_ARITHMETIC_OBLIGATIONS), but maintain distinct arithmetic representations and unproved arithmetic descent obligations without functional route isomorphism.

hypotheses: Curvature transport zero-rigidity: sum w_j delta_j^2 = 0 <=> RH (CLM-CT-008)
Sesquilinear fibre curvature rigidity: M_K''(0) = 0 <=> RH (CLM-SS-002)
Arithmetic Input Firewall enforced across all routes (CLM-ARB-009)
object_studied: Spectral zero-rigidity formulations and remaining arithmetic descent obligations
fourier_normalization: Standard centered coordinates z = a + it; tau = 2pi; spectral weights w_rho > 0
multiplicity_convention: Exact algebraic zero multiplicities and reflection pairs included
measure_and_window: Admissible regularized test functions and spectral measures
order_of_limits: Spectral sum over nontrivial zeros paired with arithmetic Dirichlet/Gamma evaluations
exact_conclusion: The 5 formulations share the same spectral zero set but possess distinct arithmetic descent obligations; they map to the shared Master Obligation OBL-RADIAL-DEFECT-DESCENT (SHARED_SPECTRAL_ZERO_SET_WITH_DISTINCT_ARITHMETIC_OBLIGATIONS).
logical_negation: The five routes have different spectral zero sets or represent completely solved arithmetic descent paths (FALSIFIED by explicit spectral zero set equality and open arithmetic descent obligations)
falsification_attempts: Tested whether any candidate route could compute A_{arith} = 0 without invoking the Euler product or RH (none can)
Tested whether any route possesses an arithmetic anchor that avoids the Master Obligation (all require OBL-RADIAL-DEFECT-DESCENT)
Audited whether Weil-Hermitian route can be proven positive without circular Weil positivity assumption (requires full explicit formula arithmetic evaluation)
Audited boundary asymptotic dominance across all 5 defect representations as gamma -> infinity and delta -> 0
Equality-case analysis: all 5 defect invariants vanish simultaneously if and only if all delta_rho = 0
